title: Badrinath Yatra
desc: Devdutt's arrest derails Satyavati's pilgrimage. He succumbs to vices, neglecting his pregnant wife. Blinded by darkness, he invites Chandravati into their home, fracturing the family. Secrets unravel, leaving behind a trail of betrayal and destruction.

title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.

title: Loha
desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

title: Mohabbat Ki Arzoo
desc: A motor mechanic posing as a rich man falls in love with a girl from a wealthy family pretending to be poor. The lovers rebel against their family members and society to remain together.
